head: 073997fb03cc06f51f55cfa00a83a761bc6544f4
title: feat(ci): GH-standard runner units + maxRunners=6 (not just 4)

critics.notes: Packing math: 3×44+4=136 ≤ 140Gi volume on 150Gi disk is sound. GH-standard 2vCPU/8Gi is the right unit. Live 5vCPU workers will CPU-starve at 3×2CPU — documented, not silent.
Topology maxSkew=1 prevents 6-on-1. Stretch 8–12 needs disk grow. Does not claim CAS hits. Capacity contract tests green.

summary: Dual-critic APPROVE: maxRunners=6 with GH Linux-sized units is host-aware and exceeds the false ceiling of 4.
